# Deepstash

> > Deepstash is a microlearning platform that replaces doomscrolling with curated insights on personal development, psychology, productivity, and self-improvement.

Deepstash offers a mobile-first learning experience with curated collections, topic directories, and book summaries designed to help users build better habits and achieve personal growth through bite-sized insights. The platform aggregates wisdom from books, articles, podcasts, and historical figures to make learning accessible and actionable.

## Key Topics

- Personal Development
- Self-Improvement
- Productivity
- Psychology
- Habit Formation
- Goal Setting
- Motivation
- Emotional Intelligence
- Stoicism
- Time Management
- Stress Management
- Learning Collections
- Microlearning
- SMART Goals
- Curated Insights

## Core Platform

- [Deepstash Homepage](https://deepstash.com): Main entry point to the microlearning app replacing doomscrolling with personal growth content
- [Browse Topics](https://deepstash.com/topics): Topic directory for exploring productivity, psychology, and self-improvement content
- [Library](https://deepstash.com/library): Curated library of books, articles, and podcasts with key insights and ideas

## Learning Topics

- [Personal Development](https://deepstash.com/topic/personaldevelopment): 100+ personal development tips from Atomic Habits and similar self-improvement books
- [Productivity](https://deepstash.com/topic/productivity): 100+ productivity tips covering time management, focus strategies, and daily habits
- [Psychology](https://deepstash.com/topic/psychology): 100+ psychology facts on human behavior, emotional intelligence, and body language
- [Motivation & Inspiration](https://deepstash.com/topic/motivationandinspiration): 100+ motivation tips and inspiration guides from books, podcasts, and articles
- [Health & Wellness](https://deepstash.com/topic/health): 100+ health and wellness facts covering mental health, biohacking, and meditation

## Curated Collections

- [The Art of Decision-Making](https://deepstash.com/collection/1149/the-art-of-decision-making): Decision-making collection featuring Kahneman's System 1/2 thinking framework
- [Soft Resilience](https://deepstash.com/collection/1157/soft-resilience): Learning collection on resilience, productivity, and habit formation
- [Inner Strength](https://deepstash.com/collection/1155/inner-strength): Collection on inner strength, stoicism, and emotional control via Marcus Aurelius
- [New Year, New You](https://deepstash.com/collection/1154/new-year-new-you): Collection on goal-setting, habit-building, and SMART goals for self-improvement
- [Lessons of History](https://deepstash.com/collection/1152/lessons-of-history): Historical learning collection featuring Voltaire and human behavior patterns

## Book Summaries

- [The Daily Stoic](https://deepstash.com/book/956/the-daily-stoic): The Daily Stoic by Ryan Holiday: stoic meditations and ancient wisdom summary
- [The 48 Laws of Power](https://deepstash.com/book/10/the-48-laws-of-power): The 48 Laws of Power by Robert Greene: summary with key insights on power dynamics
